data.name: Jadwal
data.gender_notes: Jadwal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Awd' which means 'to appoint' or 'to set'. In Islamic context, it refers to the set time for prayer or any religious obligation. The name Jadwal carries the meaning “Appointed Time, Schedule” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jadwal usually hope their child will grow to embody appointed time, schedule and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to stay connected with Allah's time and will.
data.etymology: Jadwal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Appointed Time, Schedule.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jadwal total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: جدول
in_arabic.meaning: جدول تعني جدول أو قائمة أو شيء منظم
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم جدول مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ج-د-ل' والذي يعني التدوين أو الترتيب. الجدول هو نوع من الجداول أو القوائم التي تُستخدم لتنظيم البيانات أو المعلومات. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم الجدول في العديد من المجالات مثل الرياضيات والعلوم والتنظيم الإداري. وفي السياق الإسلامي، يمكن أن يُستخدم الجدول لتنظيم مواقيت الصلاة أو الأحداث الهامة.

in_urdu.name: جدول
in_urdu.meaning: جدول کا مطلب ہے جیسے کہ فہرست، جدول، یا منظم چیز
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام جدول عربی جڑ 'ج-د-ل' سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے لکھنا یا ترتیب دینا۔ جدول ایک قسم کی فہرست یا جدول ہے جو ڈیٹا یا معلومات کو منظم کرنے کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اردو میں، جدول کا استعمال مختلف شعبوں جیسے تعلیم، انتظامیہ، اور روزمرہ زندگی میں ہوتا ہے۔ اسلامی روایت میں، جدول کو نماز کے اوقات یا اہم واقعات کو منظم کرنے کے لئے استعمال کیا جا سکتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जद्वल
in_hindi.meaning: जद्वल का अर्थ है सूची, तालिका या सुव्यवस्थित चीज़
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम जद्वल अरबी मूल 'ज-द-ल' से निकला है जिसका अर्थ है लिखना या ترتیب देना। जद्वल एक प्रकार की सूची या तालिका है जो डेटा या जानकारी को व्यवस्थित करने के लिए उपयोग की जाती है। हिंदी में, जद्वल का उपयोग विभिन्न क्षेत्रों जैसे शिक्षा, प्रशासन और दैनिक जीवन में होता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, जद्वल का उपयोग نماز के समय या महत्वपूर्ण घटनाओं को व्यवस्थित करने के लिए किया जा सकता है।

in_pashto.name: جدول
in_pashto.meaning: جدول د دې معنا چې لکه جدول، فهرست، يا منظم شوی څيز
in_pashto.long_meaning: د جدول نوم د عربي ريښو 'ج-د-ل' څخه اخستل شوی دی چې د لیکلو یا ترتیب ورکولو معنی لري. جدول د يو ډول فهرست یا جدول دی چې د معلوماتو یا ډاټا د تنظیمولو لپاره کارول کیږي. په پښتو کې، جدول په مختلفو برخو لکه تعلیم، اداره، او د ورځني ژوند په استعمال کې دی. په اسلامي دود کې، جدول د نماز د اوقاتو یا مهمو پيښو د تنظیمولو لپاره کارول کیدی شي.

in_english.name: Jadwal
in_english.meaning: Jadwal means a schedule, list, or organized plan
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jadwal originates from the Arabic root 'ج-د-ل' (jadala), which means to write, arrange, or compile. In Arabic, jadwal refers to a table, schedule, or list used to organize data or information. Historically, jadwal has been used in various contexts, including Islamic tradition, to organize important events, prayer times, or daily activities. The name conveys a sense of organization, structure, and planning, making it a meaningful choice for a child.

data.cultural_impact: The term "Jadwal" in Islamic context is an essential element of daily religious practices. It refers to the fixed schedule for performing the five daily obligatory prayers, as well as other Islamic rituals such as fasting during the month of Ramadan. Adhering to the Jadwal is considered an integral part of being a good Muslim and living in accordance with Islamic values. It is observed and implemented in mosques and communities around the world.

By following the established Islamic practices, Muslims are able to develop a strong spiritual foundation and strengthen their relationship with Allah.

historical_references.reference: The term 'Jadwal' is derived from the Arabic language and translates to 'schedule' or 'timetable'. It was commonly used during the Ottoman Empire for administrative purposes, particularly in the organization of markets and fairs.

During the late 19th and early 20th centuries, 'Jadwal' was also used in the context of Islamic education, specifically for the scheduling of prayer times and other religious observances in mosques and madrasas.

modern_usage.modern_context: The Islamic term "Jadwal", which originally referred to a schedule or timetable, has evolved to represent real-time scheduling in various modern contexts. Muslims today use Jadwal in several ways, including managing their daily prayers, fasting schedules, and other religious observances through Islamic apps. Social media platforms like Twitter and Facebook are also frequently used to share and discuss Jadwal information. Additionally, smart home devices such as Google Home and Amazon Alexa can be programmed to provide daily prayer times and other religious information based on a user's location.
